name: Nelson Steel Products Inc
old_description: Our facility provides a complete range of steel fabrication capabilities, including robotic welding and laser cutting.
about:
Nelson Steel Products Inc operates from Holland, Michigan. The company traces its roots to 1945 when Nelson Ryzenga opened Ryzenga Welding and Steel Works, a welding repair shop serving local farmers. By 1959 the business incorporated as Nelson Steel Products, Inc., and a 1968 U.S. Army trailer-frame contract spurred expansion into a large-scale production facility. The company remains family-led, with the founder's sons Wally and Roger involved in its growth.

The shop provides a full range of steel fabrication services: robotic welding across 13 stations housing 17 robots, sheet and tube laser cutting, stamping and turret punching on high-volume presses, press-brake forming, tube bending, and custom prototyping. The facility is equipped for high-volume punching and stamping runs, though total square footage and headcount are not disclosed.

Early work centered on agricultural implements, and the 1968 government contract established a military track record. Today the company serves a broader industrial base in the Midwest, positioning itself as a single source for fabricated steel components, though specific current sectors beyond agriculture and defense are not detailed in public materials.

Nelson Steel emphasizes integrity and problem-solving as its differentiators, citing decades of experience since 1945 and a "can-do attitude" that aims to make it a partner rather than just a vendor. The company's mission statement targets world-class manufacturing in fabricated metal components with on-time delivery of total-quality products.
